title: The Jade Bird
alt: An Art Nouveau playbill goes through three edits. A white peacock replaces the phoenix, a new title and subtitle fill the upper cartouche, and a ticket panel adds the venue and performance time.
description: An Art Nouveau playbill goes through three edits. A white peacock replaces the phoenix, a new title and subtitle fill the upper cartouche, and a ticket panel adds the venue and performance time.

frames.label: Generated input
frames.alt: An Art Nouveau playbill shows an orange phoenix under the title FIRE BIRD.
frames.prompt: A stunning Art Nouveau theatre playbill, flat vertical print filling the frame, cobalt and gold. A single orange phoenix perches on a curving branch beneath a golden disc, its fiery feathers curling through white lilies. At the top a wide ivory cartouche bears the meticulously typeset dark headline "FIRE BIRD"; at the very bottom a narrow navy ribbon says "ACT I". Only these two inscriptions. Distinct, perfectly legible lettering, crisp rich handmade mosaic pieces and strong composition.

frames.label: White peacock
frames.alt: A white peacock with an emerald train replaces the phoenix. FIRE BIRD and ACT I stay in print.
frames.prompt: Replace the orange phoenix illustration with a white peacock with a long emerald train and a delicate white crest on the same branch. Keep the lilies, gold disc, artwork style, and both printed inscriptions FIRE BIRD and ACT I exactly as they are.

frames.label: Title and subtitle
frames.alt: The new title THE JADE BIRD sits above the italic subtitle A BALLET IN TWO ACTS.
frames.prompt: On the upper ivory cartouche replace FIRE BIRD with “THE JADE BIRD”. Set the subtitle “A BALLET IN TWO ACTS” on a smaller line immediately beneath the title. Keep the white peacock, emerald train, gilded border and ACT I footer.

frames.label: Venue and time
frames.alt: An ivory ticket panel reads RIVER HALL and FRIDAY 18 JUNE AT 8 PM beneath the peacock.
frames.prompt: Make the bottom ACT I cartouche a two-line ivory ticket. Print “RIVER HALL” in small caps and “FRIDAY 18 JUNE AT 8 PM” below it. Keep the rest of the playbill exactly as printed.
